name: crown-blade-queue
description: Walk-in queue for Crown & Blade: keeps the public queue summary (waiting count, estimated wait, positions) up to date and tells remote customers when they are next.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build-test/test/estimate.test.js build-test/test/recompute.test.js build-test/test/templates.test.js
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore
